svg.title: Calibration, diagnostics and independent validation
svg.desc: Fit, apply, refresh diagnostics and reassess. A separate independent-data pathway applies the same fixed coefficients and checks benefit without refitting.

g.aria-label: Fit reference-on-test VM coefficients from suitable paired stages.
g.title: Fit reference-on-test VM coefficients from suitable paired stages.

g.aria-label: Apply the fitted scalar VM mapping, preserving vector direction. Inherited diagnostics are invalidated.
g.title: Apply the fitted scalar VM mapping, preserving vector direction. Inherited diagnostics are invalidated.

g.aria-label: Recompute primary-five diagnostics for the calibrated recording.
g.title: Recompute primary-five diagnostics for the calibrated recording.

g.aria-label: Compare relevant outcomes on the original and calibrated fitting recording; this is not independent validation.
g.title: Compare relevant outcomes on the original and calibrated fitting recording; this is not independent validation.

g.aria-label: Use independent recordings to assess whether fixed fitted coefficients improve the intended measurement outcomes.
g.title: Use independent recordings to assess whether fixed fitted coefficients improve the intended measurement outcomes.

g.aria-label: Apply the same fitted coefficients without refitting on the independent recordings.
g.title: Apply the same fitted coefficients without refitting on the independent recordings.

g.aria-label: Recompute diagnostics for the independently calibrated recording.
g.title: Recompute diagnostics for the independently calibrated recording.

g.aria-label: Compare errors and response against the independent reference within the intended range and processing pipeline.
g.title: Compare errors and response against the independent reference within the intended range and processing pipeline.

svg.text: Reassessment on the fitting recording does not establish independent benefit.
